defs.def: a group of twelve of the same thing （一）打；十二个

ex.s: This unbeatable price-point encouraged me to experiment with dozens of titles that I would never normally consider buying.
ex.t: 这种无可比拟的价格优势鼓励我去尝试了几十种我平时绝不会考虑购买的书籍。

ex.s: I checked out a half dozen books on Paul Revere from the library.
ex.t: 我从图书馆借了六本关于保罗·里维尔的书。

ex.s: After the coding of all submissions, half a dozen categories were noted most often as important to visitors.
ex.t: 对所有提交材料进行编码后，有六种类别最常被游客提及为重要。

ex.t: 我从图书馆借了六本关于保罗·里维尔的书。

ex.s: I began a second drawer for more general discoveries: new cave system discovered with dozens of nameless species, four hundred species of bacteria found in the human stomach.
ex.t: 我们知道什么和不知道什么的问题一直困扰着我。

ex.s: To do this I have searched through dozens of plays to find the ones that I think best show the power and purpose of the short play.
ex.t: 少数角色被用来创造一个从主题中生长出来的单一印象。

ex.s: He has written dozens of plays.
It's almost impossible to learn about one historical period without having dozens of questions about related concepts.
ex.t: 了解一个历史时期而不产生几十个相关问题几乎是不可能的。

ex.s: Last winter when I went here again, they had a big separate house to raise dozens of chicken.
ex.t: 去年冬天当我再次来这里时，他们有一栋大一些的独立房子用来养几十只鸡。

ex.s: He pulled in front of it as the wolf was catching up fast, just a dozen yards away now.
ex.t: 他冲到那辆车前面，这时狼正在快速逼近，只有十几码远了。

defs.def: a group of approximately twelve people or things 十来个；十几个；十多个

ex.s: She received dozens of awards and more than 50 honorary degrees.
ex.t: 她获得了几十个奖项和五十多个荣誉学位。

ex.s: A half-dozen others, evidently grown pups, sprang from the willows and all joined in a welcoming melee of wagging tails and playful maulings.
ex.t: 另外半打，显然是长大了的幼崽，从柳树丛中蹦出来，全都加入了摇尾巴和嬉戏打闹的欢迎混战。

ex.s: Dozens of cultural relics have been found within the city, including city walls, two sacrificial pits, building foundations, jade ware pits and a burial area, as well as several thousand fine artefacts such as bronze statues and masks.
ex.t: 在城内发现了几十件文物，包括城墙、两个祭祀坑、建筑地基、玉器坑和一个墓葬区，以及数千件精美的器物，如青铜雕像和面具。

ex.s: Dozens of polluting enterprises were closed or moved.
ex.t: 几十家污染企业被关闭或搬迁。

ex.s: I must have tried a dozen times before I caught you here.
ex.t: 我肯定试了十几次才在这里碰到你。

defs.def: a lot of people or things 许多；很多
